evidence.title: HIP: fattn-mma: use fp32 accumulation on MFMA devices by IMbackK · Pull Request #28576 · ggml-org/llama.cpp · GitHub

name: HIP: fattn-mma: use fp32 accumulation on MFMA devices (#28576)
summary: Merged llama.cpp pull request: fp32 accumulation in the HIP fattn-mma path on MFMA devices, with gfx908 flash-attention benchmarks.
description: Pull request #28576 in ggml-org/llama.cpp, merged 14 Sep 2026 from IMbackK:cdnafp32accum. It skips the post-V_MFMA fp16 downcast in the HIP fattn-mma path so MFMA (CDNA, ROCm) devices accumulate in fp32 — some performance and slightly better accuracy, at the cost of higher VGPR pressure; the 64,64,64 case was retuned. Benchmarks on gfx908 @ 190 W show 1.18–1.24x FLASH_ATTN_EXT throughput on several shapes.
contains: merged 14 Sep 2026, 2 commits from IMbackK:cdnafp32accum into ggml-org:master
post-V_MFMA fp16 downcast skipped for VKQ, so accumulation stays f32
gfx908 benchmarks: 1.18–1.24x on some FLASH_ATTN_EXT shapes; 64,64,64 case retuned
